$comment: SNAPSHOTS of the curve template arcnow.io's platform serves ON EACH NETWORK, and the gate that keeps
them honest.
READ THE TEMPLATE FROM THE CHAIN. A curve template is per-platform state, settable at any
time by that platform's admin, and snapshotted immutably onto every curve at launch. The
authoritative answer for 'what will a new launch get' is PlatformConfig.curveParametersFor(quote); for
'what did THIS token get' it is the curve itself, and never this file.
ONE CURVE, ONE TEMPLATE PER QUOTE, ONE SNAPSHOT PER NETWORK (schemaVersion 4). Every template is the
constant-product curve's: its fourth field is y0Wad, and `quote` names the quote token it is
denominated in (native USDC is 0x000...000). r0Wad, targetQuoteWad and initialPriceWad are in that
quote's WAD units. The two networks serve DIFFERENT templates: testnet's platform holds 1,000,000
supply / 50 to graduate, mainnet's the reference 1,000,000,000 / 50,000 - the same prices at a
thousand times the supply and the target. Each platform serves its template identically for native
USDC and for EURC (the same six words per quote), which is why there is one snapshot per network and
not one per quote: a second copy would give the gate two chances to disagree with itself.
WHAT EACH ENTRY IS. 'platform' non-null: a snapshot of that live platform, read at readAtBlock,
which the maintainers' template gate reads back and FAILS on any difference, and on a platform whose
VERSION() is not platform-config@4.x.x. Every network's arcnowPlatform must have one. 'platform'
null: a template no live platform serves, shipped as a starting point and checked field by field
against the vectors.json template named by vectorsTemplate, so it is never trusted unchecked; there
is none at present, because both templates arcnow.io ships are served live.
MOVING THIS FILE is a commit of its own: change the values, re-run the sync and
the template gate, and say what moved on chain. Every wad is a STRING because y0Wad does
not fit in a double and JSON has no integers.
arcnow.io's own PlatformConfig on the fee-model stack on Arc testnet, the one new launches use there.
for the pool, and a 50 USDC graduation target. Opening price 0.000016710135998192 USDC, graduation
price 0.000239156382570519 - the 14.31x of version 1, reached convexly. Set by arcnow-io/contracts
SetCurveTemplate for native USDC at block 62,389,328 and for EURC at 62,389,341; equal to ArcConstants
TESTNET_* and to vectors.json 'testnet'.
arcnow.io's own PlatformConfig on Arc mainnet, the one new launches use there. It serves
arcnow-io/contracts' REFERENCE template, ArcConstants REFERENCE_*: 1,000,000,000 total supply,
790,931,776.67 of it on the curve, a 50,000 USDC graduation target, and the same 14.312x from
0.000016710135998192 to 0.000239156382570519 as testnet at a thousand times the supply and the
target. Deploy.s.sol registered the platform with it for native USDC in the deployment block
(21,179,866); SetCurveTemplate copied the identical six words to EURC at block 21,180,663. Equal
to vectors.json 'reference'. Real money: the platform's admin can still change it for future
launches, which is exactly what the template gate reads back on every run.
